answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the shale of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on directed acyclic graph consensus for throughput.
